title: A minimal call leaves the context size unset
summary: A minimal native Ollama call must not inject options.num_ctx. Backtest: any-llm #1389 removed a hard-coded num_ctx of 32000.

requirements.text: The request leaves the context size unset.
The library sends at most one request.

grading_notes: The recorder sends no options object; thinking is switched off with the top-level think field so the call stays short. The request check verifies that the library did not add options.num_ctx.
